web.title: Spotify account
web.intro: Optional. After signing in, the wallpaper shows the next tracks and ★ likes the current track.
web.step1: Open the Spotify developer dashboard and sign in (the app owner needs Spotify Premium):
web.step2: Create app → any name; under "Redirect URIs" paste:
web.step3: Tick "Web API", save, open Settings and copy the Client ID below.
web.step4: Friends (up to 5) are added in User Management by their Spotify email.
